items.text: George Whitesides is the U.S. Representative for California’s 27th District, serving since January 2025. He was previously NASA’s chief of staff during the Obama administration and the first CEO of Virgin Galactic, where he says he created over 700 jobs in the Antelope Valley. He co-founded a policy nonprofit focused on the wildfire crisis and serves on the House Armed Services Committee and as Vice Ranking Member of the Science, Space, and Technology Committee.

sentences.text: George Whitesides is the U.S. Representative for California’s 27th District, serving since January 2025.
He was previously NASA’s chief of staff during the Obama administration and the first CEO of Virgin Galactic, where he says he created over 700 jobs in the Antelope Valley.
He co-founded a policy nonprofit focused on the wildfire crisis and serves on the House Armed Services Committee and as Vice Ranking Member of the Science, Space, and Technology Committee.

items.text: Whitesides has introduced bipartisan bills to reduce risks from artificial intelligence, including legislation to monitor self-improving AI systems and to protect children from human-like chatbots, and he has called for an industry-wide safety stand-down on frontier AI development. He joined other members to introduce the Wildfire Response and Readiness Act, which would invest in wildfire prevention and fire-safe communities, and increase pay and benefits for wildland firefighters. He supports a national film tax credit to bring production jobs back to Santa Clarita and the Antelope Valley. He voted against a resolution that he said would strip nearly $25 million from local public safety and community projects, including funding for sheriff’s mobile command posts and PFAS water treatment in Santa Clarita. According to the Los Angeles Times, he supports immigration reforms that secure the border and provide a path to citizenship for undocumented immigrants brought to the U.S. as children.

items.text: During his first week in office, he helped coordinate on-the-ground outreach following the Hurst Fire, and he co-sponsored the Fix Our Forests Act, which passed the House and aimed to improve forest management and fire prevention. He also co-sponsored a bill that passed the House to formalize collaboration between the Department of Energy and NASA on space exploration and energy innovation.
